title: Confidence changes band exactly at 30/31, 90/91, 180/181 and 365/366 days
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance, press New schedule and create a throwaway schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' holding one routine service per reading you will seed, named 'ZZ Seed 1', 'ZZ Seed 2' and so on, each with a Calendar trigger of Every 12 months and no canned lines. Save. (If it already exists, reuse it.)
  3. In Settings > Maintenance create a schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Rate PM' with one service 'PM-M': a Distance trigger set At 360,000 mileage and a Calendar trigger of Every 12 months. Save.
  4. Create eight units, 'ZZAUTOTEST 530' to 'ZZAUTOTEST 537', each as follows: Open Customers > 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' > Assets and create unit '<unit>' with New Asset, leaving Mileage and Engine Hours empty. On its Maintenance tab press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' and give every seed service a last service date five years ago (for example 6 Oct 2021), so each seed service reads Overdue and shows on the work order card; press Enroll. Enroll the unit on 'ZZAUTOTEST Rate PM' too, with PM-M last done today.
  5. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 530' (oldest first): 1) 27 Aug 2026 · 300,000 mileage; 2) 6 Sep 2026 · 301,000 mileage. (last reading 30 days old, 1 usable pair)
  6. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 531' (oldest first): 1) 26 Aug 2026 · 300,000 mileage; 2) 5 Sep 2026 · 301,000 mileage. (last reading 31 days old, 1 usable pair)
  7. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 532' (oldest first): 1) 29 May 2026 · 300,000 mileage; 2) 8 Jun 2026 · 301,000 mileage; 3) 18 Jun 2026 · 302,000 mileage; 4) 28 Jun 2026 · 303,000 mileage; 5) 8 Jul 2026 · 304,000 mileage. (last reading 90 days old, 4 usable pairs)
  8. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 533' (oldest first): 1) 28 May 2026 · 300,000 mileage; 2) 7 Jun 2026 · 301,000 mileage; 3) 17 Jun 2026 · 302,000 mileage; 4) 27 Jun 2026 · 303,000 mileage; 5) 7 Jul 2026 · 304,000 mileage. (last reading 91 days old, 4 usable pairs)
  9. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 534' (oldest first): 1) 20 Mar 2026 · 300,000 mileage; 2) 30 Mar 2026 · 301,000 mileage; 3) 9 Apr 2026 · 302,000 mileage. (last reading 180 days old, 2 usable pairs)
  10. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 535' (oldest first): 1) 19 Mar 2026 · 300,000 mileage; 2) 29 Mar 2026 · 301,000 mileage; 3) 8 Apr 2026 · 302,000 mileage. (last reading 181 days old, 2 usable pairs)
  11. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 536' (oldest first): 1) 27 Aug 2025 · 300,000 mileage; 2) 6 Sep 2025 · 301,000 mileage; 3) 16 Sep 2025 · 302,000 mileage; 4) 26 Sep 2025 · 303,000 mileage; 5) 6 Oct 2025 · 304,000 mileage. (last reading 365 days old, 4 usable pairs)
  12. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 537' (oldest first): 1) 26 Aug 2025 · 300,000 mileage; 2) 5 Sep 2025 · 301,000 mileage; 3) 15 Sep 2025 · 302,000 mileage; 4) 25 Sep 2025 · 303,000 mileage; 5) 5 Oct 2025 · 304,000 mileage. (last reading 366 days old, 4 usable pairs)
  13. Dates are for a run on 6 Oct 2026. On another day, move every date by the same number of days and seed and read on the same day, because an estimate and a reading's age both count days up to today.
  14. Seed each reading in the table, oldest first: open Work Orders and press New Work Order for the unit; type the reading's mileage in the work order's Mileage field (and its engine hours in Engine Hours where the table gives one; leave the field untouched where it does not) and save; expand the Maintenance schedule card, open the three-dot menu of a seed service not used yet, choose Mark complete, keep On a work order with this work order chosen, set Reset date to the reading's date and press Mark complete. That work order's values become readings dated the Reset date. Confirm any warning the field shows.
  15. When every reading is in: on the unit's Maintenance tab open the 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' schedule's menu, choose Remove from schedule and confirm, so the seed services add no rows. Check the Mileage card's last recorded value and date match the table's last reading.
custom_steps:
1. On the day you seed, open each unit's Maintenance tab and read the confidence word under PM-M's due month.
  2. Pair the units up (530/531, 532/533, 534/535, 536/537) and check each pair changes band between its two ages.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • 530: 30 days, 1 pair → Medium.
  • 531: 31 days, 1 pair → Low.
  • 532: 90 days, 4 pairs → High.
  • 533: 91 days, 4 pairs → Medium.
  • 534: 180 days, 2 pairs → Medium.
  • 535: 181 days, 2 pairs → Low.
  • 536: 365 days, 4 pairs → Medium.
  • 537: 366 days, 4 pairs → Low.
  • Each age is counted in whole days up to today at the location chosen in the header.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10568 (S11, Rate, estimate and confidence); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S11; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R24: “By age of the last recorded reading, then usable pairs. Up to 30 days: one pair Medium, two or more High. 31 to 90 days: one pair Low, two or three Medium, four or more High. 91 to 180 days: one pair Low, two or more Medium. 181 to 365 days: four or more Medium, fewer Low. Over 365 days: Low”
  • S12-R14: “Today is the day of the location the user is working in, as chosen in the header”
  • S18-R19: “Mark complete On a work order also records that work order's mileage and engine hours as the asset's readings, dated the Reset date”
